title: Lantern Menagerie: The Three-Moon Shadow Reel
summary: A palm-scale four-part moon gate whose captured hand wheel places connected positive rabbit, fox, and broad facial-disc owl occluders in an ordinary phone-flashlight beam. Round 2 adds a visible double-V rabbit home, 0.25 mm differential detent travel, printable snap lead-ins, two stand stops, and exact distance/alignment shadow evidence.
materials: Common rigid FFF filament; PLA or PETG candidates are not physically qualified in Make.
limitations: Digital geometry and projection checks do not prove a successful print, snap fit, detent feel, cycle life, child recognition, phone brightness, finite-emitter edge softness, or performance in a particular room.
The full transition is an intentional eclipse wipe of cropped and overlapping direct profiles; only the 0, 120, and 240 degree indexed states promise rabbit, fox, and owl.
The front-shell leaf detent is a compliant printed feature; rigid-body motion evidence excludes its intended contact and Playtest must verify it physically.
The snap entry and detent values are nominal source-derived geometry; digital checks do not prove elastic strain, insertion force, retention force, or repeated-cycle life.
